title: Soulripper
description: Would you lose your soul for just a little power?
body:
# Have you ever wanted to rip your own soul out?
## Well now you can!
Soulripper allows you to rip your soul out using /trigger Soul. And put it back in the same way!

(Below is spoilered in segments incase you want to go in without all the details)
## How does it work?


<details>
<summary>Your soul</summary>

So to start, your soul is a totem of undying. To get your soul, you must use /trigger Soul to rip it out of your body. Now, this does come with a major drawback. You'll be capped at 6 hearts without your soul. But just put it back in using /trigger Soul to get back to normal.

</details>




<details>
<summary>Why?</summary>

Now you may be questioning. "Why should I rip my soul out?" Well, I'm glad you asked. You see, in "soulless" mode, you deal more damage than a regular player. (Attack damage is at 5.) Plus you also get a totem. Falling from the sky after a shulker decided to shoot you into the sky? Quickly rip your soul out to survive the fall! Dying in lava? Your soul will grant you fire resistance.

</details>




<details>
<summary>The problem. (and solution)</summary>

There is one slight problem though. Once you lose your soul. You don't have one to put back in your body. Well, all you need to do is find a replacement! Just kill an evoker, get the totem. And put that thing in ya! It'll fit good as new!

</details>
